verdicts.explanation: The home page itself raises the question of brand identity ('Who makes curl?') but carries no Organization or sameAs markup that would let an assistant anchor curl.se to a verified entity, so the gap the check reports is real.

site_specific: Add an Organization JSON-LD block to the home page naming curl.se as the publisher.
Include a sameAs array pointing at the project's own official profiles (its GitHub org, official mailing lists page) so an assistant can confirm this is the same curl referenced elsewhere.
Keep the block on the home page since that is the page the check and most inbound links target.
Wrap 'What is curl used for?' and the paragraph that follows it in FAQPage/Question JSON-LD.
Do the same for 'Who makes curl?' and 'What is the latest curl?' since both are already phrased as questions in the page's own headings.
Keep each answer self-contained so an assistant can lift the question and answer as one unit without the surrounding page.

fixes.quote: curl command line tool and library for transferring data with URLs
site_specific: Publish an XML sitemap listing the site's pages (docs, dev/ section, release notes) at a stable path such as /sitemap.xml.
Declare that sitemap's location in robots.txt with a Sitemap: line.
Regenerate the sitemap when new release or dev pages are added so link discovery does not depend solely on crawling internal links.

fixes.quote: Everything curl is an extensive, detailed and totally free book, available in multiple formats.
site_specific: Add a lang attribute set to en on the top-level html element in the site's shared page template.
Rebuild the generated pages (book.html, dashboard.html, the dev section) from that template so the attribute appears on all of them, not just the home page.

fixes.quote: curl command line tool and library for transferring data with URLs
site_specific: Add a single top-level heading (h1) to the home page stating what curl is, for example wrapping the existing opening line 'curl command line tool and library for transferring data with URLs'.
Keep the current headings (What is curl used for?, Who makes curl?, etc.) as subordinate h2 headings under it.
